content_sections.heading: Namo Hospital Daman Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 22 vacancies are available - 3 for Anaesthetist, 2 for Physician, 2 for Gynecologist, 2 for Orthopaedic Surgeon, 2 for Ophthalmic Surgeon, 2 for Psychiatrist, 1 for Radiologist, 1 for ENT Surgeon, 2 for Pathologist, 2 for General Surgeon, 2 for Paediatrician and 1 for Dermatologist.

content_sections.heading: Namo Hospital Daman Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: MBBS with PG Degree or Diploma in respective subject MS/ MD/ DNB from an institute recognized by NMC/ MCI as per prevailing norms. Registered with National Medical Council (NMC) OR State Medical Council (SMC). Experience may be preferred. Knowledge of Local Language is desirable.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for Namo Hospital Daman Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to submit the presentation for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The deadline for submitting the presentation (soft/hard copy) is 07 September 2026, before 5:00 PM. Ensure it is submitted to the office or emailed to [email protected].

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to report at the venue by 10:00 AM on the day of the walk-in interview, which is scheduled for 08 September 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You need to carry one set of attested photocopies of your educational qualifications, experience certificates, and other relevant documents. All original documents must also be brought for verification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a walk-in interview and a presentation. The presentation should highlight your professional achievements, experience, and other relevant contributions.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for a fresh candidate with a Degree?
faq.answer: For a fresh candidate with a Degree, the basis salary is Rs. 1,25,000/- pm, with an incentive of Rs. 25,000/- pm, making the gross remuneration Rs. 1,50,000/- pm.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for a candidate with 5 years of experience and a Diploma?
faq.answer: A candidate with 5 years of experience and a Diploma will receive a basis salary of Rs. 1,25,000/- pm, plus an incentive of Rs. 25,000/- pm, totaling Rs. 1,50,000/- pm as gross remuneration.

faq.question: Q7. Is experience mandatory for these positions?
faq.answer: Experience may be preferred, but it is not explicitly stated as mandatory in the initial announcement. Candidates with relevant experience are encouraged to apply.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for these positions at Namo Hospital Daman?
faq.answer: The job type for these positions is on a Contract basis, as indicated in the recruitment details.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at the Conference Hall, Namo Hospital, Daman. The address is Daman, Pincode: 396210.

faq.question: Q10. What is the total number of vacancies announced?
faq.answer: Namo Hospital Daman has announced a total of 22 vacancies for various specialist posts, including Medical Superintendent.
